fullPassage: Modern Thai boxing, as practiced in the two major stadiums in Bangkok, is something to behold. The golden era of Thai boxing started around the late 1970s and continued into the early 1990s. This was when the sport took a giant leap into modernity. In the matches, light gloves are worn, and kicking is permitted. There are typically 10 fights per night, each of which lasts 5 rounds of 3 minutes each. Each stadium is small, holding only about 1,000 spectators, almost all of whom are males, but many other people stand outside and follow the action intently by radio or, in some cases, television. Before a fight, each fighter performs a small ritual indicating the school or philosophy of fighting in which he has been trained. An Asian band plays throughout each round, but slowly in the first two rounds. In the third round, the band increases its sound and speed, thus exciting the crowd, and many fans rise excitedly and begin to place bets through the use of hand movements.

❌ ② (A) 학교 - (B) 유파/학파: (A)에서 '학교'는 philosophy와 병렬 부적절. (B)에서 '유파'는 맥락에 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ (A) 유파/학파 - (B) 유파/학파: (B)는 일상 '학교'임이 분명.
❌ ④ (A) 학교 - (B) 학교: (A)는 싸움의 유파이지 교육기관이 아님.
det.tip: school: 1. 학교(교육기관) 2. 유파, 학파(사상이나 기법의 흐름). 문맥에 따라 의미 결정.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"A series of actions performed in a fixed order, especially as part of a ceremony."

det.analysis:
✅ ③ ritual: 의식의 일부로 정해진 순서대로 수행되는 일련의 행위 = 의식.
❌ ① crowd: '군중'은 사람들 무리이지 행위가 아님.
❌ ② speed: '속도'는 행위의 순서와 무관.
❌ ④ fight: '싸움'은 의식이 아님.
det.tip: ritual = 의식, 격식을 갖춘 행위. ceremony와 유사.

questions.passage: In the third round, the band increases its sound and speed, thus __________ (excite) the crowd, and many fans rise excitedly.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: excite(동사: 흥분시키다) -> exciting(현재분사). 'thus exciting the crowd'는 분사구문으로 '그리하여 관중을 흥분시키며'라는 의미. 원문과 동일.
det.tip: thus + V-ing: 그리하여 ~하며. 분사구문 형태.

questions.passage: Before a fight, each fighter performs a small ritual __________ (indicate) the school or philosophy of fighting in which he has been trained.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: indicate(동사: 나타내다) -> indicating(현재분사). 'a small ritual indicating ...'에서 ritual을 뒤에서 수식하는 분사. 원문 그대로.
det.tip: 명사 + V-ing: 현재분사가 명사를 뒤에서 수식. '~하는 명사'.

questions.passage: Modern Thai boxing, as practiced in the two major stadiums in Bangkok, is something to behold. The golden era of Thai boxing started around the late 1970s and continued into the early 1990s. This was when the sport took a giant leap into modernity. In the matches, light gloves are worn, and kicking is permitted. There are typically 10 fights per night, each of which lasts 5 rounds of 3 minutes each. Each stadium is small, holding only about 1,000 spectators, almost all of whom are males, but many other people stand outside and follow the action intently by radio or, in some cases, television. Before a fight, each fighter performs a small ritual indicating the school or philosophy of fighting in which he has been trained. An Asian band plays throughout each round, but slowly in the first two rounds. In the third round, the band increases its sound and speed, thus exciting the crowd, and many fans rise excitedly and begin to __________ through the use of hand movements.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ place bets: 흥분한 팬들이 3라운드에서 손동작을 이용해 '내기를 건다'는 것이 원문 내용.
❌ ① sing songs: 본문은 관중이 노래를 부른다는 언급 없음.
❌ ② leave quickly: 팬들이 '흥분해서 일어섰다'는 맥락과 모순.
❌ ③ read newspapers: 신문 읽기는 경기장 분위기와 무관.
det.tip: place bets = 내기를 걸다. 손동작으로 도박을 하는 타이 복싱 경기장의 특이한 문화.

questions.passage: Modern Thai boxing, as practiced in the two major stadiums in Bangkok, is something to behold. The golden era of Thai boxing started around the late 1970s and continued into the early 1990s. This was when the sport took a __________ into modernity. In the matches, light gloves are worn, and kicking is permitted. There are typically 10 fights per night, each of which lasts 5 rounds of 3 minutes each. Each stadium is small, holding only about 1,000 spectators, almost all of whom are males, but many other people stand outside and follow the action intently by radio or, in some cases, television. Before a fight, each fighter performs a small ritual indicating the school or philosophy of fighting in which he has been trained. An Asian band plays throughout each round, but slowly in the first two rounds. In the third round, the band increases its sound and speed, thus exciting the crowd, and many fans rise excitedly and begin to place bets through the use of hand movements.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② giant leap: 황금기에 타이 복싱이 현대성으로 '거대한 도약'을 이루었다는 원문. 스포츠의 급격한 발전을 표현.
❌ ① small step: '작은 걸음'은 이후 황금기 설명과 어울리지 않음.
❌ ③ slow walk: '느린 걸음'은 변화의 규모를 축소.
❌ ④ quiet pause: '조용한 멈춤'은 발전과 정반대.
det.tip: take a giant leap = 거대한 도약을 하다. '큰 발전'을 뜻하는 관용 표현.
